leaves.title: עמידה
leaves.comment: Condition reviewed: was "Ten Days" and node Avinu Malkeinu

segs.en: Amidah for Shacharit on a weekday
segs.text: עמידה לשחרית של יום חול
אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

parts.text: וֵֽאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב. הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא,
וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַֽהֲבָה:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: </small> מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ וּמָגֵן: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יַהַוַהַ,

segs.text: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי, מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה, רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ.

parts.text: וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמֽוּנָתוֹ לִֽישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרוֹת,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: </small> וְנֶֽאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַֽחֲיוֹת מֵתִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֵהֵוֵהֵ,

segs.en: Kedushah
segs.text: <small>קדושה</small>

segs.en: We say in the chazzan's repetition
segs.text: <small>בחזרת הש"ץ אומרים</small>

parts.text: נַקְדִּישָׁךְ וְנַעֲרִיצָךְ, כְּנֹֽעַם שִֽׂיחַ סוֹד שַׂרְפֵי קֹֽדֶשׁ, הַמְשַׁלְּשִׁים לְךָ קְדֻשָּׁה,
קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה ׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּיָֽהּ:
וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל־יוֹם יְהַֽלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֹהֵוָהֵ,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: אַתָּה חוֹנֵן לְאָדָם דַּֽעַת וּמְלַמֵּד לֶאֱנוֹשׁ בִּינָה. וְחָנֵּֽנוּ מֵאִתְּךָ חָכְמָה בִּינָה וָדָֽעַת: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יַהַוַהַ, חוֹנֵן הַדָּֽעַת:
הֲשִׁיבֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ לְתֽוֹרָתֶֽךָ, וְקָֽרְבֵֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַֽעֲבֽוֹדָתֶֽךָ, וְהַֽחֲזִירֵֽנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֵהֵוֵהֵ, הָרוֹצֶה בִּתְשׁוּבָה:
סְלַח לָֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כִּי חָטָֽאנוּ, מְחוֹל לָֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כִּי פָשָֽׁעְנוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָֽתָּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֶהֶוֶהֶ, חַנּוּן הַמַּרְבֶּה לִסְלֹחַ:
רְאֵה נָא בְעָנְיֵֽנוּ, וְרִיבָֽה רִיבֵֽנוּ, וּמַהֵר לְגָאֳלֵֽנוּ גְאוּלָּה שְׁלֵמָה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ, כִּי אֵל גּוֹאֵל חָזָק אָֽתָּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהְוְהְ, גּוֹאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל:

segs.en: On a fast day, the chazzan says in the repetition:
segs.text: <small>בתענית ציבור השליח ציבור אומר בחזרה</small>

parts.text: עֲנֵֽנוּ אָבִינוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ בְּיוֹם צוֹם הַתַּֽעֲנִית הַזֶּה, כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָֽחְנוּ. אַל־תֵּֽפֶן לְרִשְׁעֵֽנוּ, וְאַל־תִּתְעַלָּם מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מִבַּקָּשָׁתֵֽנוּ. הֱיֵה נָא קָרוֹב לְשַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ, טֶֽרֶם נִקְרָא אֵלֶֽיךָ אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה, נְדַבֵּר וְאַתָּה תִשְׁמַע, כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהָיָ֥ה טֶֽרֶם־יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַאֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע: כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל, וְעוֹנֶה וּמְרַחֵם בְּכָל־עֵת צָרָה וְצוּקָה:
<small>בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הָעוֹנֶה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵת צָרָה:</small>

segs.text: רְפָאֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה וְנֵֽרָפֵא, הֽוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה, כִּי תְהִלָּתֵֽנוּ אָֽתָּה, וְהַֽעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה וּמַרְפֵּא לְכָל־תַּֽחֲלוּאֵֽינוּ וּלְכָל־מַכְאוֹבֵֽינוּ וּלְכָל־מַכּוֹתֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֵל רוֹפֵא רַחְמָן וְנֶֽאֱמָן אָֽתָּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֹהֹוֹהֹ, רוֹפֵא חוֹלֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:

segs.en: In summer:
segs.text: <small>בקיץ:</small>

segs.gloss: Summer version of the blessing for the years
segs.text: בָּֽרְכֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּכָל־מַֽעֲשֵׂי יָדֵֽינוּ, וּבָרֵךְ שְׁנָתֵֽנוּ בְּטַֽלְלֵי רָצוֹן בְּרָכָה וּנְדָבָה, וּתְהִי אַֽחֲרִיתָהּ חַיִּים וְשָׂבָע וְשָׁלוֹם כַּשָּׁנִים הַטּוֹבוֹת לִבְרָכָה, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יִהִוִהִ, מְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים:

segs.en: In winter:
segs.text: <small>בחורף:</small>

segs.gloss: Winter version of the blessing for the years
segs.text: בָּרֵךְ עָלֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת־הַשָּׁנָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת־כָּל־מִינֵי תְּבוּאָתָהּ לְטוֹבָה, וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה עַל כָּל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה, וְרַוֵּה פְּנֵי תֵבֵל וְשַׂבַּע אֶת־הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ מִטּוּבָךְ, וּמַלֵּא יָדֵֽינוּ מִבִּרְכוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמֵעֹֽשֶׁר מַתְּנוֹת יָדֶֽיךָ. שָׁמְרָה וְהַצִּֽילָה שָׁנָה זוֹ מִכָּל־דָּבָר רָע, וּמִכָּל־מִינֵי מַשְׁחִית וּמִכָּל־מִינֵי פֻרְעָנוּת, וַעֲשֵׂה לָהּ תִּקְוָה טוֹבָה וְאַחֲרִית שָׁלוֹם. חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֶֽיהָ וְעַל כָּל־תְּבוּאָתָהּ וּפֵירוֹתֶיהָ, וּבָֽרְכָֽהּ בְּגִשְׁמֵי רָצוֹן בְּרָכָה וּנְדָבָה, וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתָהּ חַיִּים וְשָׂבָע וְשָׁלוֹם. כַּשָּׁנִים הַטּוֹבוֹת לִבְרָכָה, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יִהִוִהִ, מְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים:

תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵֽרוּתֵֽנוּ, וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּֽלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ, וְקַבְּצֵֽנוּ יַֽחַד מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ לְאַרְצֵֽנוּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֻהֻוֻהֻ, מְקַבֵּץ נִדְחֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:

parts.text: וְהָסֵר מִמֶּֽנּוּ יָגוֹן וַֽאֲנָחָה. וּמְלוֹךְ עָלֵֽינוּ מְהֵרָה אַתָּה יְהֹוָה לְבַדְּךָ,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: לַמִּינִים וְלַמַּלְשִׁינִים אַל־תְּהִי תִקְוָה, וְכָל־הַזֵּדִים כְּרֶֽגַע יֹאבֵֽדוּ, וְכָל־אֽוֹיְבֶֽיךָ וְכָל־שֽׂוֹנְאֶֽיךָ מְהֵרָה יִכָּרֵֽתוּ, וּמַלְכוּת הָֽרִשְׁעָה מְהֵרָה תְעַקֵּר וּתְשַׁבֵּר וּתְכַלֵּם וְתַכְנִיעֵם בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יָהָוָהָ, שׁוֹבֵר אוֹיְבִים וּמַכְנִֽיעַ מִינִים:

עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים וְעַל הַֽחֲסִידִים, וְעַל שְׁאֵרִית עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית סֽוֹפְרֵיהֶם, וְעַל גֵּרֵי הַצֶּֽדֶק וְעָלֵֽינוּ, יֶֽהֱמוּ נָא רַֽחֲמֶֽיךָ, יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְתֵן שָׂכָר טוֹב לְכָל־הַבּֽוֹטְחִים בְּשִׁמְךָ בֶּֽאֱמֶת, וְשִׂים חֶלְקֵֽנוּ עִמָּהֶם. וּלְעוֹלָם לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ כִּי בְךָ בָטָֽחְנוּ, וְעַל חַסְדְּךָ הַגָּדוֹל בֶּֽאֱמֶת נִשְׁעָֽנְנוּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יוּהוּווּהוּ, מִשְׁעָן וּמִבְטָח לַצַּדִּיקִים:

תִּשְׁכּוֹן בְּתוֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִֽירְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ, וְכִסֵּא דָוִד עַבְדְּךָ מְהֵרָה בְּתוֹכָהּ תָּכִין, וּבְנֵה אוֹתָהּ בִּנְיַן עוֹלָם בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֻהֻוֻהֻ, בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָיִם:
אֶת צֶֽמַח דָּוִד עַבְדְּךָ מְהֵרָה תַצְמִֽיחַ, וְקַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בִּישֽׁוּעָתֶֽךָ, כִּי לִֽישׁוּעָֽתְךָ קִוִּֽינוּ כָּל־הַיּוֹם: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יִהִוִהִ, מַצְמִֽיחַ קֶֽרֶן יְשׁוּעָה:

שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ, יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, אָב הָרַֽחֲמָן, רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ, וְקַבֵּל בְּרַֽחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלּוֹת וְתַֽחֲנוּנִים אָֽתָּה. וּמִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, רֵיקָם אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵֽנוּ, חָנֵּֽנוּ וַֽעֲנֵֽנוּ וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ.

parts.en: On a fast day, the individual says Aneinu here; a chazzan who forgot to say it between Geulah and Refuah says it here, without the closing blessing.
parts.text: <small><small>בתענית אומר היחיד עננו, וכן שליח ציבור ששכח לומר בין גואל לרופא יאמר כאן עננו בלי חתימה</small></small>

עֲנֵנוּ אָבִינוּ עֲנֵנוּ בְּיוֹם צוֹם הַתַּֽעֲנִית הַזֶּה כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָֽחְנוּ. אַל־תֵּֽפֶן לְרִשְׁעֵֽנוּ, וְאַל־תִּתְעַלָּם מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מִבַּקָּשָׁתֵֽנוּ. הֱיֵה נָא קָרוֹב לְשַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ. טֶֽרֶם נִקְרָא אֵלֶֽיךָ אַתָּה תַֽעֲנֶה, נְדַבֵּר וְאַתָּה תִשְׁמַע, כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהָיָ֥ה טֶֽרֶם־יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַאֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע: כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל וְעוֹנֶה וּמְרַחֵם בְּכָל־עֵת צָרָה וְצוּקָה.

parts.en: The text of Aneinu for the three fasts

parts.text: עֲנֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ בְּיוֹם צוֹם הַתַּֽעֲנִית הַזֶּה כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָֽחְנוּ,
עַל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר חָטָֽאנוּ עָוִֽינוּ פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה חָֽרְבָֽה עִירֵֽנוּ וְשָׁמֵם מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ,
אוֹי וַאֲבוֹי לָנוּ כִּי עֲוֹנֹתֵֽינוּ הִטּוּ אֵֽלֶּה וּפְשָׁעֵֽינוּ הֶאֱרִיכוּ קִצֵּֽנוּ,
אֵין לָֽנוּ פֶּה לְהָשִׁיב וְלֹא מֵֽצַח לְהָרִים רֹאשׁ,
וּכְמוֹ צַֽעַר בְּנַפְשֵֽׁנוּ עַל חֻרְבַּן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וּבִטּוּל תּוֹרָה וַעֲבוֹדָה זֶה כַּמָּה מֵאוֹת שָׁנִים וְזֶה צַֽעַ״ר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם,
אֲהָהּ עָלֵֽינוּ. לָכֵן עַתָּה שַֽׁבְנוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ בְּבֹֽשֶׁת וְחֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה וּבְדֶֽמַע לֵב נְבַקְשָׁה מֵאֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מְרַחֵם,
יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ,
שֶׁיְּהֵא מִעוּט חֶלְבֵּֽנוּ וְדָמֵֽינוּ הַמִּתְמָעֵט בְּתַעֲנִיתֵֽנוּ הַיּוֹם כַּחֵֽלֶב מֻנָּח עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ,
שֶׁתְּכַפֵּר בּוֹ כָּל־חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ עֲוֹנֹתֵֽינוּ וּפְשָׁעֵֽינוּ. הָאֵר פָּנֶֽיךָ עַל מִקְדָּֽשְׁךָֽ הַשָּׁמֵם לְמַֽעַן אֲדֹנָי,
וְאַל־תִּתְעַלָּם מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מִבַּקָּשָׁתֵֽנוּ. הֱיֵה נָא קָרוֹב לְשַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ. טֶֽרֶם נִקְרָא אֵלֶֽיךָ אַתָּה תַֽעֲנֶה,

כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהָיָ֥ה טֶֽרֶם־יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַאֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע: כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל וְעוֹנֶה וּמְרַחֵם בְּכָל־עֵת צָרָה וְצוּקָה.</small>

segs.text: כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלַּת כָּל־פֶּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יֹהְוָה, שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה:

רְצֵה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵׁב הָֽעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ, וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם, מְהֵרָה בְּאַֽהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן, וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:

segs.en: On Rosh Chodesh and Chol HaMoed, say:
segs.text: <small>בראש חודש ובחול המועד אומרים:</small>

<small>אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא, וְיַגִּֽיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה, וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע, וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר, זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, זִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירָךְ, וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן־דָּוִד עַבְדָּךְ, וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל־עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶֽיךָ, לִפְלֵיטָה, לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן, לְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם, בְּיוֹם</small>

<small>לְרַחֵם בּוֹ עָלֵֽינוּ וּלְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ. זָכְרֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים, בִּדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים. חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ, וַחֲמוֹל וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה:</small>
וְאַתָּה בְּרַֽחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים, תַּחְפֹּץ בָּֽנוּ וְתִרְצֵֽנוּ, וְתֶֽחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשֽׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַֽחֲמִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יִהִוִהִ, הַמַּֽחֲזִיר שְׁכִֽינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

segs.en: In the blessing of Modim, bow at Modim and rise at the Name (Ben Ish Chai, Beshalach 21).
segs.text: <small>בברכת "מודים" יכרע ב"מודים" ויזקוף בשם <small>(בא"ח בשלח הכ"א)</small></small>

parts.text: לָךְ, שֶׁאַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵֽאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּרֵֽנוּ צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ וּמָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ אַתָּה הוּא, לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ, עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטֽוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָֽהֳרָֽיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ, הַמְּרַחֵם, כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵֽעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:

segs.en: Modim d'Rabbanan
segs.text: מודים דרבנן

segs.en: In the Chazzan's repetition, when the Chazzan says 'Modim', the congregation says:
segs.text: <small>בחזרת הש"ץ כשהחזן אומר מודים, הקהל אומרים:</small>

<small>מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ, שֶׁאַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי כָל בָּשָׁר, יוֹצְרֵנוּ יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית. בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּנוּ. כֵּן תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּתְחָנֵּנוּ וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ, לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ וּלְעָבְדְךָ בְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם, עַל שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ, בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת.</small>

segs.en: On Chanukah and Purim, say:
segs.text: <small>בחנוכה ופורים אומרים:</small>
עַל הַנִּסִּים וְעַל הַפֻּרְקָן וְעַל הַגְּבוּרוֹת וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּעוֹת וְעַל הַנִּפְלָאוֹת וְעַל הַנֶּחָמוֹת שֶׁעָשִֽׂיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם בַּזְּמַן הַזֶּה:

parts.text: בִּימֵי מַתִּתְיָה בֶן־יוֹחָנָן כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל. חַשְׁמוֹנָאִי וּבָנָיו כְּשֶׁעָֽמְדָֽה מַלְכוּת יָוָן הָרְשָׁעָה עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל. לְשַׁכְּחָם תּוֹרָתָךְ וּלְהַעֲבִירָם מֵחֻקֵּי רְצוֹנָךְ. וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים עָמַֽדְתָּ לָהֶם בְּעֵת צָרָתָם. רַֽבְתָּ אֶת רִיבָם. דַּֽנְתָּ אֶת דִּינָם. נָקַֽמְתָּ אֶת נִקְמָתָם. מָסַֽרְתָּ גִבּוֹרִים בְּיַד חַלָּשִׁים. וְרַבִּים בְּיַד מְעַטִּים. וּרְשָׁעִים בְּיַד צַדִּיקִים. וּטְמֵאִים בְּיַד טְהוֹרִים. וְזֵדִים בְּיַד עֽוֹסְקֵֽי תוֹרָתֶֽךָ. לְךָ עָשִֽׂיתָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ בְּעוֹלָמָךְ. וּלְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשִֽׂיתָ תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וּפֻרְקָן כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּֽאוּ בָנֶֽיךָ לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ. וּפִנּוּ אֶת־הֵיכָלֶֽךָ. וְטִהֲרוּ אֶת־מִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ. וְהִדְלִֽיקוּ נֵרוֹת בְּחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. וְקָֽבְעֽוּ שְׁמוֹנַת יְמֵי חֲנֻכָּה אֵֽלּוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדָאָה. וְעָשִֽׂיתָ עִמָּהֶם נִסִּים וְנִפְלָאוֹת וְנוֹדֶה לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל סֶֽלָה:

בִּימֵי מָרְדְּכַי וְאֶסְתֵּר בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה. כְּשֶׁעָמַד עֲלֵיהֶם הָמָן הָרָשָׁע. בִּקֵּשׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד לַהֲרֹג וּלְאַבֵּד אֶת־כָּל־הַיְּהוּדִים מִנַּֽעַר וְעַד זָקֵן טַף וְנָשִׁים בְּיוֹם אֶחָד. בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר לְחֹֽדֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר. הוּא חֹֽדֶשׁ אֲדָר. וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז. וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים הֵפַֽרְתָּ אֶת־עֲצָתוֹ וְקִלְקַֽלְתָּ אֶת־מַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ. וַהֲשֵׁבֽוֹתָ לּוֹ גְּמוּלוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ. וְתָלוּ אוֹתוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו עַל הָעֵץ. וְעָשִֽׂיתָ עִמָּהֶם נֵס וָפֶֽלֶא וְנוֹדֶה לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל סֶֽלָה:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: וּכְתֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ.</small>
וִֽיהַֽלְלוּ וִֽיבָֽרְכוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל בֶּֽאֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב,

segs.en: Priestly Blessing
segs.text: ברכת כהנים

parts.en: When the kohen lifts his feet to raise his hands, he says (Ben Ish Chai, Tetzaveh 12):
parts.text: <small><small>כשעוקר הכהן רגליו לישא כפיו יאמר (בא"ח תצוה י"ב)</small>

לְשֵׁם יִחוּד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ. בִּדְחִֽילוּ וּרְחִֽימוּ. וּרְחִֽימוּ וּדְחִֽילוּ. לְיַחֲדָא שֵׁם יוֹ"ד קֵ"א בְּוָא"ו קֵ"א בְּיִחוּדָא שְׁלִים. בְּשֵׁם כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מוּכָן וּמְזוּמָן לְקַיֵּם מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּרְכַּת כֹּהַנִים בִּנְשִׂיאוּת כַּפַּיִם,

לַעֲשׂוֹת נַֽחַת רֽוּחַ לְיֽוֹצְרֵֽנוּ וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ שֶׁפַע וּבְרָכָה לְכָל־הָעוֹלָמוֹת וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹן בּֽוֹרְאֵֽנוּ. וִיהִ֤י ׀ נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ: </small>

parts.en: When the kohanim stand on the platform after answering 'Modim d'Rabbanan', say:
parts.text: <small><small>וכשעומדים הכהנים על הדוכן לאחר שענו "מודים דרבנן", אומרים</small>

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁתִּהְיֶה בְּרָכָה זוֹ שֶׁצִּּוִיתָֽנוּ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרָכָה שְׁלֵמָה וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָהּ מִכְשׁוֹל וְעָוֹן מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:

parts.en: In the chazzan's repetition, say the Priestly Blessing. If there is more than one kohen, the chazzan calls them:
parts.text: <small>בחזרת הש"ץ אומרים ברכת כהנים, אם יש יותר מכהן אחד קורא להם החזן:</small>

segs.en: And the chazzan and the kohanim say word for word:
segs.text: <small>ואומר החזן והכהנים אחריו מילה במילה:</small>

parts.text: <small>יִשָּׂ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃</small>

segs.en: If there are no kohanim, the chazzan says:
segs.text: <small><small>אם אין כהנים אומר החזן:</small></small>
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ, הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁיךָ כָּאָמוּר:

parts.text: <small>יִשָּׂ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃</small>
וְשָׂמ֥וּ אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י עַל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲנִ֖י אֲבָרְכֵֽם:</small>

segs.en: When the prayer leader begins 'Sim Shalom' the kohanim turn their faces towards the sanctuary and say:
segs.text: <small>כשמתחיל שליח ציבור "שים שלום" מחזירין כהנים פניהם כלפי ההיכל ואומרים:</small>

<small>רִבּוֹן הָעוֹלָמִים עָשִֽׂינוּ מַה־שֶּׁגָּזַֽרְתָּ עָלֵֽינוּ, עַשֵׂה אַתָּה מַה־שֶּׁהִבְטָחְתָּֽנוּ. הַשְׁקִ֩יפָה֩ מִמְּע֨וֹן קׇדְשְׁךָ֜ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל:</small>

parts.text: עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ. וּבָֽרְכֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כֻּלָּֽנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ,
כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ נָתַֽתָּ לָּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ תּוֹרָה וְחַיִּים,
בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָֽרְכֵֽנוּ וּלְבָרֵךְ אֶת־כָּל־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: הַמְּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם. אָמֵן:

segs.text: יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן ׀ אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃

parts.text: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וְשִׂפְתוֹתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה,
וְאַחֲרֵי מִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי. וְכָל־הַקָּמִים עָלַי לְרָעָה,
<small>יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהֹוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה. קַבֵּל רִנַּת עַמֶּךָ. שַׂגְּבֵנוּ טַהֲרֵנוּ נוֹרָא.</small>

parts.en: A remedy: say the verse that begins and ends with the same letter as the name you are invoking.
parts.text: <small>סגולה לומר פסוק המתחיל וגומר באות שמתחיל וגומר שמו</small>
לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי:
יִֽהְי֥וּ לְרָצ֨וֹן ׀ אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃

parts.en: Some say the prayer of Rav (Berakhot 16b), which the Chida wrote in his siddur:
parts.text: <small>יש אומרים תפילת רב מגמרה ברכות ט"ז ע"ב שכתב החיד"א ז"ל בסידורו</small>
חַיִּים שֶׁתְּהֵא בָֽנוּ אַהֲבַת תּוֹרָה וְיִרְאַת שָׁמַֽיִם,

segs.en: Bow, take three steps back as if taking leave of the Divine Presence, then bow left, right and center, while saying:
segs.text: <small>כורע ופוסע שלוש פסיעות לאחור, ואחר כך משתחווה שמאלה, ימינה ואמצע, ואומר:</small>

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance, say:

segs.text: <small>יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵֽאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, שֶׁתִּבְנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְתוֹרָתָךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֵּי רְצוֹנָךְ וּלְעָבְדָךְ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם:</small>

segs.en: On Rosh Chodesh, say Hallel here.
segs.text: <small>בראש חודש אומרים כאן הלל</small>

segs.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance, say:
segs.text: <small>בעשרת ימי תשובה אומרים:</small>
אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָטָאנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ:
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָתָּה:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חַדֵּשׁ עָלֵינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ בַּטֵּל מֵעָלֵינוּ כָּל־גְּזֵרוֹת קָשׁוֹת וְרָעוֹת:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ בַּטֵּל מַחְשְׁבוֹת שֹׂנְאֵינוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ הָפֵר עֲצַת אוֹיְבֵינוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כַּלֵּה כָּל צַר וּמַשְׂטִין מֵעָלֵינוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כַּלֵּה דֶבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָה וְרָעָב וּשְׁבִי וּבִזָּה וּמַשְׁחִית וּמַגֵּפָה וְיֵצֶר הָרָע וְחוֹלָאִים רָעִים מִבְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ שְׁלַח רְפוּאָה שְׁלֵמָה לְכָל חוֹלֵי עַמֶּךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ מְנַע מַגֵּפָה מִנַּחֲלָתֶךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ זָכוּר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ מְחוֹל וּסְלַח לְכָל עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ:</small>

parts.en: (Have in mind the name Kera Satan)

segs.text: <small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ מְחוֹק בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים כָּל שִׁטְרֵי חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵינוּ מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים טוֹבִים:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר צַדִּיקִים וַחֲסִידִים:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר יְשָׁרִים וּתְמִימִים:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר פַּרְנָסָה וְכַלְכָּלָה טוֹבָה:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר מְחִילָה וּסְלִיחָה וְכַפָּרָה:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר גְּאֻלָּה וִישׁוּעָה:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ זָכְרֵנוּ בְּזִכְרוֹן טוֹב מִלְּפָנֶיךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ הַצְמַח לָנוּ יְשׁוּעָה בְּקָרוֹב:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ הָרֵם קֶרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְהָרֵם קֶרֶן מְשִׁיחֶךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ הַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ שְׁמַע קוֹלֵנוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעֲנָךְ אִם לֹא לְמַעֲנֵנוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ קַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ:</small>
<small>אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אַל תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּפָנֶיךָ:</small>

segs.en: On days when Tachanun is not said, we say:
segs.text: <small>בימים שאין בהם תחנון אומרים</small>

parts.text: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ רָ֖ם עַל־כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָה־אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

parts.en: And then the chazzan says Half Kaddish

segs.text: Weekday Shacharit Amidah
Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

parts.text: Blessed are You, Lord our God and God of our ancestors, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; God great, mighty, and awesome; supreme God, who bestows kindness and possesses all things, who remembers the kindness of the ancestors and brings a redeemer to their descendants for His name’s sake, in love.
Remember us for life, King who desires life, and inscribe us in the book of life, for Your sake, living God.
King, helper, savior, and shield! Blessed are You, Lord, Shield of Abraham.

segs.text: You are mighty forever, Lord; You revive the dead and are abundant in salvation.

parts.text: In summer: “who makes the dew fall.”
In winter: “who makes the wind blow and the rain fall.”

You sustain the living with kindness and revive the dead with great compassion. You support the fallen, heal the sick, free the bound, and keep faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of might? Who compares to You, King who brings death and life and causes salvation to grow?
Who is like You, merciful Father, who remembers His creatures for life in mercy?
You are faithful to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Lord, who revives the dead.

segs.text: Kedushah (said during the prayer leader’s repetition with a minyan; when praying alone, continue at “You are holy.”)

We will sanctify You & revere You, like the pleasant conversation, of the assembly of the holy Serafim (angels) that recite holiness thrice before You. And as it is written by Your prophet: And one calls to the other & says : Holy, Holy, Holy is the L·rd of hosts; the entire world is filled with His glory. Those facing them, give praise & say: Blessed is the honor of the L·rd from His place. And in Your holy words it is written, stating: The L·rd will reign forever, your G·d, oh zion, for every generation, Halleluy·ah. (Praise G·d!)

parts.text: You are Holy, & Your Name is holy, & Your holy ones will praise You every day, forever. Blessed are You L·rd the
(10 days of repentance – the Holy King)

segs.text: You graciously bestow knowledge to man, & teach mortals understanding, graciously bestow upon us from Yourself wisdom, understanding & knowledge. Blessed are You L·rd, Who graciously bestows knowledge.
Return us, our Father, to Your Torah & approach us, our King, to Your service, & bring us back to complete repentance before You. Blessed are You L·rd, Who desires repentance.
Pardon us, our Father, for we transgressed. Forgive us, our King for we sinned. For You are a good & forgiving G·d. Blessed are You L·rd, gracious One, Who abundantly pardons.
Behold, please, our affliction & fight our battle, & speedily redeem us, [with] a complete redemption, for Your Name. For You G·d, are a mighty Redeemer, Blessed are You L·rd, Redeemer of Yisrael.

Answer us, our Father, answer us on this day of fast, for we are in great distress. Do not turn to our wickedness, and do not hide Yourself, our King, from our plea. Be near, please, to our cry; before we call to You, You will answer; while we speak, You will hear, as it is said: “Before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will hear.” For You, Hashem, redeem and rescue, and answer and have compassion in every time of trouble and distress. Blessed are You, Hashem, who answers His people Israel in time of trouble.

Heal us, L·rd, & we will be healed. Save us & we will be saved, for You are our Praise. And bring a cure & healing for all of our ailments, & all our pains, & all our wounds for, G·d You are a compassionate & faithful healer. Blessed are You L·rd, Who heals the ill of His people, Yisrael.

Bless us, L·rd, our G·d, in all the works of our hands & bless our years with dews of favor, blessing & benevolence, & let its end be with life, & satiety & peace, like the best years of blessing, for You are a good & benevolent G·d & You bless the years. Blessed are You L·rd, Who blesses the years.
[In Winter]

Bless for us, L·rd, our G·d, this year, & all types of its produce for good, & provide dew & rain for blessing on the entire face of the land & quench the face of the earth, & satiate the entire world with Your good, & fill our hands from Your blessings & the wealth of the gifts of Your hands. Protect & save this year from any bad thing, & any kind of destruction, & any kind of retribution, & make for it good hope, & an ending of peace. Have compassion & mercy upon it & upon all of its produce & fruits, & bless it with rains of goodwill, blessing & benevolence, & let its end be with life, & satiety & peace, like the good years of blessing, for You are a good & benevolent G·d & You bless the years. Blessed are You L·rd, Who blesses the years.

Sound a great Shofar (rams horn for Mashiah'), for our freedom, & raise a flag to gather our exiles, & assemble us together quickly from the four corners of the earth to our land (of Israel). Blessed are You, that assembles the displaced of His people, Israel.

parts.text: Restore our Judges (of the Sanhedrin) as at first, & our advisers as in the beginning, & remove from us sorrow & groan, & rule upon us speedily, You alone L·rd, with lovingkindness & compassion, with righteousness & justice Blessed are You, L·rd,
[In 10 Days of Repentance Say instead: The King, The Judge]

segs.text: For the informers & the heretics, let there be no hope. And all the wicked, let them perish in an instant, And all Your enemies & all Your haters, may they quickly be terminated, & as for a wicked government, may You uproot & smash & terminate & subdue them speedily in our days. Blessed are You, L·rd, Who smashes the enemies & subdues wicked. (the Heretics)

Upon the righteous & the pious, & all the remnant of Your people, the House of Israel, & on their elders, & on the remnant of the academies of [Torah] sages, & upon the righteous converts & upon us, awaken, please, Your mercy L·rd, our G·d, & give us good reward, to all that have true faith in Your Name, & place our lot with them, & upon Your great mercy, we truly rely. Blessed are You, L·rd, a support & an assurance, for the righteous.

Dwell within Jerusalem Your city, as You spoke about, & the throne of David, Your servant, speedily prepare it within it, & build it an eternal structure speedily in our days. Blessed are You, L·rd, Who builds Jerusalem.

May the offspring of David, Your servant, soon flourish, and may You raise his power through Your salvation, for we hope for Your salvation all day long. Blessed are You, Lord, who causes the power of salvation to flourish.

Hear our voice L·rd our G·d, merciful Father, have pity & mercy upon us, & accept with mercy & favor our prayers, for You are G·d, Who hears prayers & supplications. And from before You, our King, do not send us back empty [handed], grace us [with benevolence], & respond to us & hear our prayers,...

Answer us, our Father, answer us on this day of fast, for we are in great distress. Do not turn to our wickedness, and do not hide Yourself, our King, from our plea. Be near, please, to our cry; before we call to You, You will answer; while we speak, You will hear, as it is said: “Before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will hear.” For You, Hashem, redeem and rescue, and answer and have compassion in every time of trouble and distress.

Answer us, our Father, answer us on this day of fast, for we are in great distress, because of all that we have sinned, been guilty of, and transgressed, we and our fathers. Because of this our city was laid waste and our Sanctuary made desolate. Woe and alas for us, for our iniquities have brought these things, and our transgressions have prolonged our end. We have no mouth to answer and no face to lift our head. And as there is anguish in our souls over the destruction of the Temple and the cessation of Torah and the service, these many hundreds of years, and over the grief of Heaven, alas for us! Therefore we now return to You in shame, disgrace and humiliation, and with a tear in the heart we beseech our merciful God: Please, Hashem, may it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that the diminishing of our fat and our blood, which is diminished by our fast today, be as the fat placed upon the altar, to atone with it for all our sins, iniquities and transgressions. Cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate Sanctuary, for the sake of the Lord, and let a redeemer come to Zion. Do not turn to our wickedness, and do not hide Yourself, our King, from our plea. Be near, please, to our cry; before we call to You, You will answer; while we speak, You will hear, as it is said: “Before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will hear.” For You, Hashem, redeem and rescue, and answer and have compassion in every time of trouble and distress.
For You hear the prayer of every mouth. Blessed are You, Lord, who hears prayer.

Find favor, L·rd, our G·d, in Your people Israel, & to their prayers turn, & restore the [divine offering] service to the inner Sanctuary of Your house, & the fires [of the offerings] of Israel & their prayers speedily lovingly accept with favor, & let You continually have satisfaction from the service of Your people Israel.
(Rosh Hodesh, Intermed. days Passover & Sukot say)

Our G·d, & G·d of Our forefathers, may it rise, & come, arrive, appear, find favor, & be heard, & be considered, & be remembered & our remembrance, & the remembrance of our Patriarchs, & the remembrance of Jerusalem, Your city, & the remembrance of the Messiah, the son of David, Your servant, & the remembrance of your entire People, the house of Israel before You – for deliverance, for good, for grace, for kindness, & mercy, for a good life, on this day of
(on Rosh Hodesh) the head of the month
(on Passover) the Holiday of Matzot
(on Sukkot) Holiday of Sukkot. On this day of Holy Convocation,

to have mercy on it (this day) upon us & to save us. Remember L·rd, our G·d, on it for good, & consider us on it with blessing, & deliver us on it for good life, With a pronouncement of deliverance & mercy. Take pity & be gracious to us, & have mercy & be compassionate with us & save us for upon You are our eyes turned, For You are G·d, King, gracious & compassionate.
And You, with Your great compassion, desire us & let us be dear, & may our eyes see Your return to Zion with compassion. Bless You, L·rd, Who returns His Divine Presence to Zion.
[Upon Saying "Modim" / "We are Grateful" One Bows]

We are grateful to You, that You are He Who is the L·rd, our G·d, & G·d of our fathers forever, & our Rock, the Rock of our lives & You are He Who is a Shield of salvation. For each & every generation, we will thank You & will relate Your praise, upon our lives that are placed in Your Hands, & upon our souls, that are entrusted in Your hands (when we sleep), & upon Your miracles that all day are with us, & all Your wonders & goodness at all times, at night, & morning & afternoon. The Good [One], for Your mercy never ends, The Merciful [One are You], for Your loving-kindness never ceases, forever we have hope in You.

We give thanks to You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of all flesh, our Creator, Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanksgivings to Your great and holy Name for having kept us alive and sustained us. So may You keep us alive and be gracious to us, and gather our exiles to the courtyards of Your sanctuary, to keep Your statutes, to do Your will, and to serve You with a whole heart, for we give thanks to You. Blessed is the God of thanksgivings.
*(Al HaNissim) (on Purim & Hanuka an extra prayer is added here)

For the miracles, and for the redemption, and for the mighty deeds, and for the saving acts, and for the wonders, and for the consolations that You performed for our fathers in those days, at this time.

In the days of Mattityahu, son of Yochanan the High Priest, the Hasmonean, and his sons, when the wicked Greek kingdom rose up against Your people Israel to make them forget Your Torah and to turn them away from the statutes of Your will, You, in Your abundant mercy, stood by them in their time of distress. You waged their battle, You judged their claim, You avenged their wrong. You delivered the strong into the hands of the weak, the many into the hands of the few, the impure into the hands of the pure, the wicked into the hands of the righteous, and the willful sinners into the hands of those who occupy themselves with Your Torah. You made a great and holy name for Yourself in Your world, and for Your people Israel You performed a great salvation and redemption to this very day. And afterward Your children came into the inner sanctuary of Your House, cleared Your Temple, purified Your Sanctuary, and kindled lights in the courtyards of Your holy place, and established these eight days of Chanukah to give thanks and praise. And You performed miracles and wonders with them, and we give thanks to Your great Name forever.

In the days of Mordechai and Esther in Shushan the capital, when the wicked Haman stood up against them and sought to destroy, slay and exterminate all the Jews, young and old, children and women, in one day, on the thirteenth of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, and to plunder their possessions. But You, in Your abundant mercy, nullified his counsel and frustrated his plan, and returned his reward upon his own head; and they hanged him and his sons on the gallows. And You performed a miracle and a wonder with them, and we give thanks to Your great Name forever.

parts.text: Upon all of these, You are Blessed, You are Exalted & Uplifted (in our mouths) always, Your Name, our King, forever & ever & all the living will praise You evermore.
And inscribe all the children of Your covenant for a good life.

And they will praise, & they will bless Your Great Name truely, constantly, for It is good, the G·d of our Salvation & our Assistance, the Good G·d. Blessed are You L·rd, the Good, Your Name & You are befitting to give thanks.

segs.text: For the sake of the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah, in fear and love, and love and fear, to unify the Name Yud-Kei with Vav-Kei in perfect unity, in the name of all Israel: behold, I am ready and prepared to fulfill the positive commandment of blessing Israel with the Priestly Blessing by raising the hands, to bring contentment to our Maker, to draw down abundance and blessing to all the worlds, and to do the will of our Creator. “May the pleasantness of my Lord our God be upon us; establish the work of our hands upon us, and the work of our hands, establish it.”

parts.text:
[When the priests stand on the platform after they recited the responsive Modim, they say:]
May it be Your Will before You, Lord, our God and God of our fathers, that this blessing that You have commanded us to bless Your people Israel be a complete blessing and that there not be within it any obstacle or iniquity from now and forever.

segs.text:
[During the prayer leader’s repetition, they now say the priestly blessing. If there is more than one priest, one of the congregants calls out:] Priests! [The priests recite the blessing:]
Blessed are You, Lord, our God, King of the universe, who has sanctified us with the holiness of Aaron and commanded us to bless His people Israel with love. [Cong. answers, Amen!]
[The prayer leader says the following one word at a time, with the priests repeating each word after him:]
May the Lord bless you and protect you. [Cong. answers, Amen!]
May the Lord shine His countenance upon you and give you grace. [Cong. answers, Amen!]
May the Lord lift His countenance upon you and give you peace. [Cong. answers, Amen!]
[If there are no priests, the prayer leader says:]

Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing of the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken by the mouth of Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people – as it is said:
May the Lord bless you and protect you. [Cong. answers, Thus may it Be His Will!]
May the Lord shine His countenance upon you and give you grace. [Cong. answers, Thus may it Be His Will!]
May the Lord lift His countenance upon you and give you peace. [Cong. answers, Thus may it Be His Will!]

parts.text: [When the prayer leader begins Sim Shalom, the priests turn their faces towards the sanctuary and say:]

Master of the worlds, we have done what You have decreed upon us. You [should then] do that which you have promised: Look down from Your holy abode, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel (Deuteronomy 26:15).

Establish peace, good, & blessing, life, grace & kindness, & compassion upon us & upon all Israel, Your Nation, & bless us our Father all of us together with the light of Your countenance, For with the light of Your countenance, You gave us, L·rd, our G·d, Torah & Life, Love & Kindness, Righteousness & Compassion, Blessing & Peace, & it is Good in Your eyes to bless us, & to bless all Your people Israel, with great force & peace.

In the book of life, blessing and peace, good livelihood, salvation and consolation, and good decrees, may we be remembered and inscribed before You, we and all Your people, the House of Israel, for a good life and for peace.
Blessed are You L·rd, Who Blesses His people of Israel with Peace. Amen.

segs.text: May they find favor, the words of my mouth & the thoughts of my heart, before You, L·rd, my Rock & my Redeemer.

My G·d! Guard my tongue from Bad, & my lips from [speaking] deceit. And those that curse me, let my soul be silent. And let my soul be like the dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, & after Your Mitzvot (commandments) let my soul pursue, & all that rise against me for bad, quickly nullify their counsel & ruin their thoughts. Do [it] for the sake of Your Name, do [it] for the sake of Your right (mercy), do [it] for the sake of Your Torah, do [it] for the sake of Your Holiness. For the sake of refraining Your beloved (Israel, from sufferance), Your right (mercy) Deliver [us], & answer us.
So that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me.
May they find favor [from You] - the saying of my mouth & the reflections of my heart before You, my L·rd, my Rock & my Redeemer.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that You grant us long life, a life of peace, a life of goodness, a life of blessing, a life of sustenance, a life of physical vigor, a life in which there is fear of sin, a life in which there is no shame or disgrace, a life of wealth and honor, a life in which we have love of Torah and fear of Heaven, a life in which You fulfill all the desires of our heart for good.
He Who makes peace from the heights, may He with His compassion, make peace upon us & all His people Israel, & [Let us] say, Amen.

May it be Your will before You, L·rd, Our G-d and G-d of our fathers – that You build the Holy Temple speedily in our days. And give us our share in Your Torah – to do the laws of Your will and to serve You with a perfect heart.
[On Rosh Hodesh / Head of Month - One Says Hallel Here]
Avinu Malkenu – / Our Father Our King - said 10 days of repentance
Our Father, Our King – we sinned before You, have mercy upon us
Our Father, Our King We have no king, other than You
Our Father, Our King do it [have mercy] for us for Your Name
Our Father, Our King, Renew for us a Good Year
Our Father, Our King nullify from us all All Evil & Hard Decrees
Our Father, Our King Nullify the thoughts of those who hate us
Our Father, Our King, overturn the counsel of our enemies
Our Father, Our King – extinguish all pain & accusations against us
Our Father, Our King – remove pestilence, and the sword and bad and hunger and captivity and plunder and the destroyer and plague and evil inclination and bad illness from the people of your covenant
Our Father, Our King, send a complete healing to all the ill of your people
Our Father, Our King, prevent a plagues from your heritage
Our Father, Our King, remember that we are [only] dust
Our Father, Our King, forgive and pardon all our transgressions
Our Father, Our King, tear up all of our bad judgements
Our Father, Our King with your great mercy erase all our contracts of debt
Our Father, Our King erase and remove our sins before your Eyes
Our Father, Our King, inscribe us in the book of good life
Our Father, Our King, inscribe us in the book of the righteous and pious
Our Father, Our King, inscribe us in the book of the straight and simple
Our Father, Our King, inscribe us in the book of good income & sustenance
Our Father, Our King, inscribe us in the book of forgiveness, pardon & atonement
Our Father, Our King inscribe us in the book of redemption & salvation
Our Father, Our King remember us with a good remembrance before You
Our Father, Our King let the salvation sprout speedily
Our Father, Our King, raise the horn of Yisrael, Your people
Our Father, Our King, and raise the horn of Your Messiah
Our Father, Our King, have grace upon us and answer us
Our Father, Our King, return us to complete repentance before You
Our Father, Our King, listen to our voice [of prayer] & have pity & be merciful upon us
Our Father, Our King, do it for Your sake if not for our own sake
Our Father, Our King, accept with mercy and goodwill our prayers
Our Father, Our King, do not return us empty-[handed] before You

May the Name of Hashem be blessed from now and forever. From the rising of the sun to its setting, the Name of Hashem is praised. Hashem is high above all nations; His glory is above the heavens. Hashem, our Lord, how mighty is Your Name in all the earth!

segs.en: Vidui (Confession)
segs.text: וידוי

parts.text: אָנָּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. תָּבֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ. וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מַלְכֵּנוּ מִתְּחִנָּתֵנוּ. שֶׁאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָאנוּ. אֲבָל חָטָאנוּ. עָוִינוּ. פָּשַׁעְנוּ. אֲנַחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵיתֵנוּ:

אָשַׁמְנוּ. בָּגַדְנוּ. גָּזַלְנוּ. דִּבַּרְנוּ דֹפִי וְלָשׁוֹן הָרָע. הֶעֱוִינוּ. וְהִרְשַׁעְנוּ. זַדְנוּ. חָמַסְנוּ. טָפַלְנוּ שֶׁקֶר וּמִרְמָה. יָעַצְנוּ עֵצוֹת רָעוֹת. כִּזַּבְנוּ. כָּעַסְנוּ. לַצְנוּ. מָרַדְנוּ. מָרִינוּ דְבָרֶיךָ. נִאַצְנוּ. נִאַפְנוּ. סָרַרְנוּ. עָוִינוּ. פָּשַׁעְנוּ. פָּגַמְנוּ. צָרַרְנוּ. צִעַרְנוּ אָב וָאֵם. קִשִּׁינוּ עֹרֶף. רָשַׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַתְנוּ. תִּעַבְנוּ. תָּעִינוּ וְתִעֲתַעְנוּ.
וְסַרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֹא שָׁוָה לָנוּ. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל־כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ. כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִׂיתָ. וַאֲנַחְנוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ:

segs.text: אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם אַתָּה וּבַעַל הָרַחֲמִים. גְּדֻלַּת רַחֲמֶיךָ וַחֲסָדֶיךָ הוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם. וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ. וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙:
רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן חָטָאנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְהושִׁיעֵנוּ:

segs.en: Sit and say:
segs.text: <small>ישב ויאמר</small>

parts.text:
אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃ אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַעַלְצ֖וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃ גַּ֣ם כָּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃ דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י ׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכׇר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהֹוָֽה׃ טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהֹוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃ יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃ כׇּל־אׇרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הֹוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃ לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃ מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃ ס֣וֹד יְ֭הֹוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃ עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃ פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחׇנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃ צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃ רְאֵ֣ה עׇ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכׇל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃ רְאֵֽה־אֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃ שׇׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃ תֹּם־וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃ פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָרוֹתָֽיו׃
וְ֭הוּא יִפְדֶּ֣ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל עֲוֺנֹתָֽיו׃

segs.text: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ. וְהִנָּחֵם עַל הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּךָ:

אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, אָבִינוּ אָתָּה. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָתָּה. אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים. עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶסֶד לְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ: וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֤א נֵדַע֙ מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֥י עָלֶ֖יךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃

זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃ אַֽל־תִּזְכׇּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֢ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃ עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃ חׇנֵּ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה חׇנֵּ֑נוּ כִּי־רַ֗֝ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃ בְּרֹגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר. בְּרֹגֶז אַהֲבָה תִּזְכּוֹר. בְּרֹגֶז עֲקֵדָה תִּזְכּוֹר. בְּרֹגֶז תְּמִימוּת תִּזְכּוֹר: יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ עׇזְרֵ֤נוּ ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַֽל־דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

segs.en: On public fast days, the additional supplications found in the section Fasts and Mourning are said here.
segs.text: <small>בתעניות ציבור אומרים כאן תחנונים נוספים שנמצאים ב"תעניות ואבילות"</small>

segs.en: On Mondays and Thursdays this Kaddish is not said; continue with El Melech.
segs.text: <small>בימים שני וחמישי אין אומרים את הקדיש הזה וממשיכים באל מלך</small>

parts.text: בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל,
יְהֵא שְׁמֵיהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא
יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח. וְיִתְפָּאַר. וְיִתְרוֹמַם. וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא. וְיִתְהַדָּר. וְיִתְעַלֶּה. וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא,

segs.en: On Mondays and Thursdays, add:
segs.text: <small>בימי שני וחמישי מוסיפים:</small>

אֶל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים, עוֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל, אֶל, הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכוֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙:

אַנְשֵׁי אֱמוּנָה אָבָדוּ, בָּאִים בְּכֹחַ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם: גִּבּוֹרִים לַעֲמֹד בַּפֶּרֶץ, דּוֹחִים אֶת הַגְּזֵרוֹת: הָיוּ לָנוּ לְחוֹמָה, וּלְמַחְסֶה בְּיוֹם זָעַם: זוֹעֲכִים אַף בְּלַחֲשָׁם, חֵמָה עָצְרוּ בְּשַׁוְעָם: טֶרֶם קְרָאוּךָ עֲנִיתָם, יוֹדְעִים לַעֲתֹר וּלְרַצּוֹת: כְּאָב רִחַמְתָּ לְמַעֲנָם, לֹא הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ פְנֵיהֶם רֵיקָם: מֵרֹב עֲוֹנֵינוּ אֲבַדְנוּם, נֶאֶסְפוּ מֶנּוּ בַּחֲטָאֵינוּ: סָעוּ הֵמָּה לִמְנוּחוֹת, עָזְבוּ אוֹתָנוּ לַאֲנָחוֹת: פַּסּוּ גוֹדְרֵי גָדֵר, צֻמְּתוּ מְשִׁיבֵי חֵמָה: קָמִים בַּפֶּרֶץ אַיִן, רְאוּיִים לרַצּוֹתְךָ אָפֵסוּ: שׁוֹטַטְנוּ בְּאַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת, תְּרוּפָה לֹא מָצָאנוּ: שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בּבֹשֶׁת פָּנֵינוּ, לְשַׁחֲרָךְ אֵל בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵינוּ:

אֶל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים, עוֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל, אֶל, הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכוֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙:

תָּמַהְנוּ מֵרָעוֹת. תָּשַׁשׁ כֹּחֵנוּ מִצָּרוֹת. שַׁחְנוּ עַד לִמְאֹד, שָׁפַלְנוּ עַד עָפָר. רַחוּם כָּךְ הִיא מִדָּתֵנוּ, קְשֵׁי עֹרֶף וּמַמְרִים אֲנָחְנוּ. צָעַקְנוּ בְּפִינוּ חָטָאנוּ, פְּתַלְתּוֹל וְעִקֵּשׁ לִבֵּנוּ. עֶלְיוֹן, רַחֲמֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם, סְלִיחָה עִמְּךָ הִיא. נִחָם עַל הָרָעָה, מַטֵּה כְּלַפֵּי חֶסֶד. לֹא תִתְעַלַּם בְּעִתּוֹת כָּאֵל, כִּי בְּצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָחְנוּ. יִוָּדַע לְעֵינֵי הַכֹּל, טוּבְךָ וְחַסְדְּךָ עִמָּנוּ. חֲתֹם פֶּה-שָׂטָן, וְאַל יַשְׂטִין עָלֵינוּ, זְעֹם בּוֹ וְיִדֹּם. וְיַעֲמֹד מֵלִיץ טוֹב לְצַדְּקֵנוּ, הוּא יַגִּיד יָשְׁרֵנוּ. דְּרָכֶיךָ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן גִּלִּיתָ לְנֶאֱמַן בָּיִת. בְּבַקְשׁוֹ אָז מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, אֱמוּנָתְךָ הוֹדַעְתָּ לּוֹ:

אֶל מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רַחֲמִים וּמִתְנַהֵג בַּחֲסִידוּת, מוֹחֵל עֲוֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ, מַעֲבִיר רִאשׁוֹן רִאשׁוֹן. מַרְבֶּה מְחִילָה לַחַטָּאִים, וּסְלִיחָה לַפּוֹשְׁעִים, עוֹשֶׂה צְדָקוֹת עִם כָּל בָּשָׂר וְרוּחַ, לֹא כְרָעָתָם לָהֶם גּוֹמֵל, אֶל, הוֹרֵתָנוּ לוֹמַר מִדּוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה, זְכוֹר לָנוּ הַיּוֹם בְּרִית שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוֹדַעְתָּ לֶעָנָו מִקֶּדֶם, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתָךְ וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהֹוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה: וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:

וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃ נֹצֵ֥ר‏ חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. אַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָּלָה, תֹּאחֵז יָדְךָ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. בְּבֹא תוֹכֵחָה נֶגְדֶּךָ, שְׁמֵנוּ מִסִּפְרְךָ אַל תֶּמַח. גִּשְׁתְּךָ לַחֲקֹר מוּסָר, רַחֲמֶיךָ יקַדְּמוּ רָגְזֶךָ. דַּלּוּת מַעֲשִׂים בְּשׁוּרֶךָ, קָרֵב צֶדֶק מֵאֵלֶיךָ. הוֹרֵנוּ, בְּזַעֲקֵנוּ לָךְ, צַו יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ בְּמַפְגִּיעַ. וְתָשִׁיב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי תָם, פְּתָחָיו רְאֵה כִּי שָׁמֵמוּ. זְכֹר נָאַמְתָּ, עֵדוּת לֹא תִשָּׁכַח מִפִּי זַרְעוֹ. חוֹתַם תְּעוּדָה תַּתִּיר, סוֹדְךָ שִׂים בְּלִמּוּדֶיךָ. טַבּוּר אַגַּן הַסַּהַר, נָא אַל יֶחְסַר הַמָּזֶג. יָהּ, דַּע אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוּךָ, מַגֵּר אֶת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדָעוּךָ. כִּי תָשִׁיב לְבִצָּרוֹן, לְכוּדִים אֲסִירֵי הַתִּקְוָה.

מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם, וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים, הֲלֹא הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ, אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם, וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָּל חָי, אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָטֶן, רֹאֶה כְלָיוֹת וָלֵב. אֵין דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִמָּךָּ, וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ:

יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁתִּמְחֹל לָנוּ אֶת-כָּל-חַטֹּאתֵינוּ, וּתְכַפֵּר לָנוּ אֶת-כָּל-עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ, וְתִמְחֹל וְתִסְלַח לְכָל פְּשָׁעֵינוּ, וְסָלַחְתָּ֛ לַעֲוֺנֵ֥נוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵ֖נוּ וּנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ:

סְלַח לָנוּ אָבִינוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ, מְחֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֗֝סֶד לְכׇל־קֹֽרְאֶֽיךָ׃ לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃ לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓ ׀ תּוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ: הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ ונשוב [וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָה] חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃

וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַֽ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־יָ֝עִ֗יר כׇּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ ׀ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ: אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמׇר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃ כִּֽי־עִמְּךָ֥ הַסְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא׃ לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃ אִם־עֲוֺנֵ֙ינוּ֙ עָ֣נוּ בָ֔נוּ יְהֹוָ֕ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑ךָ׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃ יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃ יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים. עֲשֵׂה עִמָּנוּ צְדָקָה כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:

parts.text: אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁר֩ הוֹצֵ֨אתָ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֜ מֵאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃ אֲדֹנָ֗י כְּכׇל־צִדְקֹתֶ֙ךָ֙ יָֽשׇׁב־נָ֤א אַפְּךָ֙ וַחֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ מֵעִֽירְךָ֥ יְרוּשָׁלַ֖‍ִם הַר־קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּ֤י בַחֲטָאֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבַעֲוֺנ֣וֹת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יְרוּשָׁלַ֧‍ִם וְעַמְּךָ֛ לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ׃ וְעַתָּ֣ה ׀ שְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְאֶל־תַּ֣חֲנוּנָ֔יו וְהָאֵ֣ר פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ֖ הַשָּׁמֵ֑ם לְמַ֖עַן אֲדֹנָֽי׃ הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשְׁמָע֒ פקחה [פְּקַ֣ח] עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃

segs.text: אָבִינוּ אָב הָרַחֲמָן, הַרְאֵנוּ אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְקַבֵּץ נְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ. יַכִּירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל הַגּוֹיִם כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אָבִינוּ אָתָּה. אֲנַחְנוּ הַחֹמֶר וְאַתָּה יֹצְרֵנוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדְךָ כֻּלָּנוּ:

אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, צוּרֵנוּ וְגוֹאֲלֵנוּ, ח֧וּסָה יְהֹוָ֣ה עַל־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשׇׁל־בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ יָדַעְנוּ יְהֹוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ. וְאֵין מִי יַעֲמוֹד בַּעֲדֵנוּ אֶלָּא שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יַעֲמוֹד לָנוּ בְּעֵת צָרָה. וּכְרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ. חֲמֹל עַל עַמָּךְ וְרַחֵם עַל נַחֲלָתָךְ. חוּסָה נָּא כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ חָנֵּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַצְּדָקָה עוֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת בְּכָל עֵת וָעֵת. הַבֵּט נָא וְהוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא צֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ. אַל יִמְשָׁל בָּנוּ קֶצֶף כִּי לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה בְּךָ תוֹחַלְתֵּנוּ. אֱלוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת אָנָּא סְלַח נָא. כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָתָּה:

אָנָּא מֶלֶךְ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן, זְכוֹר וְהַבֵּט לִבְרִית בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים. וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶיךָ עֲקֵדַת יָחִיד. וּלְמַעַן יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִינוּ. אַל תַּעַזְבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ. וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְאַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ יוֹצְרֵנוּ. וְאַל תַּעַשׂ עִמָּנוּ כָלָה בְּגָלוּתֵינוּ. כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה:

אֵין כָּמוֹךָ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֱלֹהֵינוּ. אֵין כָּמוֹךָ אֵל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת. הושִׁיעֵנוּ וְרַחֲמֵנוּ מֵרַעַשׁ וּמֵרֹגֶז הַצִּילֵנוּ: זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃ וְהָסֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מַכַּת הַמָּוֶת כִּי רַחוּם אָתָּה. כִּי כֵן דַּרְכְּךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֶסֶד חִנָּם בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָנָּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָֽא׃ אָנָּא יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ: לְךָ יְהֹוָה קִוִּינוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה חִכִּינוּ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה נְיַחֵל אַל תֶּחֱשֶׁה וּתְעַנֵּנוּ. כִּי נָאֲמוּ גוֹיִם אָבְדָה תִקְוָתָם. כָּל בֶּרֶךְ לְךָ תִכְרַע וְכָל קוֹמָה לְפָנֶיךָ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה:

הַפּוֹתֵחַ יָד בִּתְשׁוּבָה לְקַבֵּל פּוֹשְׁעִים וְחַטָּאִים. נִבְהֲלָה נַפְשֵׁנוּ מֵרוֹב עִצְּבוֹנֵנוּ. אַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ נֶצַח קוּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ. אַל תִּשְׁפּוֹךְ חֲרוֹנְךָ עָלֵינוּ כִּי עַמְּךָ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ. אֵל הַבִּיטָה. דַּל כְּבוֹדֵנוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְשִׁקְּצוּנוּ כְּטֻמְאַת הַנִּדָּה. עַד מָתַי עֻזְּךָ בַּשְּׁבִי וְתִפְאַרְתְּךָ בְּיַד צָר. הֵמָּה יִרְאוּ וְיֵבשׁוּ וְיֵחַתּוּ מִגְּבוּרָתָם. עוֹרְרָה גְבוּרָתְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. אַל יִמְעֲטוּ לְפָנֶיךָ תְּלָאוֹתֵינוּ מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵנוּ. לֹא לְמַעֲנֵנוּ אֶלָּא לְמַעֲנָךְ פְּעֹל וְאַל תַּשְׁחֵת אֶת זֵכֶר שְׁאֵרִיתֵנוּ. כִּי לְךָ מְיַחֲלוֹת עֵינֵינוּ כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה. וּזְכוֹר עֵדוּתֵינוּ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד אוֹמְרִים פַּעֲמַיִם בְּאַהֲבָה: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד׃

parts.text: בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל,
יְהֵא שְׁמֵיהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא
יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח. וְיִתְפָּאַר. וְיִתְרוֹמַם. וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא. וְיִתְהַדָּר. וְיִתְעַלֶּה. וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא,

segs.text: Please L·rd, Our G·d and G·d of Our Fathers – Let Our Prayer come before You & do not conceal Yourself, Our King, from our supplications. For we are not brazen faced & stiff necked to say before You, L·rd, our G-d & G-d of our Fathers – we are righteous and we have not sinned. Rather we have sinned, we have been crooked and transgressed – we and our fathers and the people of our household. We were guilty. We Rebelled. We Stole. We spoke slander and evil speech. We caused iniquity, We caused evil. We did intentional bad. We did violence. We accused falsely and deceitfully. We provided bad advice. We spoke falsity. We became angry. We mocked. We rebelled. We rebelled against your word. We provoked. We committed adultery. We left the path. We transgressed deliberately. We damaged. We caused pain. We caused pain to our father and mother. We were stiff necked. We were evil. We destroyed. We did despicable things. We made people err. We left Your Commandments and Your good laws & they were not worthy of us. And You are righteous on everything that happens to us – for You did truth and we acted wickedly.

G·d, long to anger You are and a Master of mercy. The Greatness of Your mercifulness and kindness recall today for Your beloved seed, like You told the humble one [Moshe / Moses] from old. And also it is written in Your Torah: “And the L·rd descended in a cloud & stood with him [Moshe/ Moses] there [in the tent of meeting]. And he called out with name – L·rd – and there it is said:...

And the L·rd passed by before him [Moshe] and he called: L·rd, L·rd – 1) G·d 2) Merciful & 3) Gracious, 4) Long 5) to anger and 6) Great in Kindness 7) and Truth. 8) His Kindness is faithful 9) for thousands [of generations] 10) He bears iniquity, 11) and sin 12) and transgression 13) and absolves [those who repent].
Merciful & Gracious One, We sinned before you – have mercy upon us and save us.
(say while seated)

[A Psalm] by David – To You L·rd do I lift my soul. My G·d I have faith in You – Don't let me be embarrassed or let my enemies exult. Also all who have faith – let them not be embarrassed, let the enemies be embarrassed for naught. Let me understand me your ways L·rd and teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth and teach [it to] me – for You are the G·d of my salvation – in You I have faith all day. Remember Your mercy – L·rd – and Your kindness – for they are eternal. The sins of my youth and transgressions do not recall because of your kindness You remember me because of Your goodness. Good & justare You L·rd – therefor You show sinners the [proper] path. You guide the humble with justice and You teach the humble his way. All the paths of the L·rd are kindness & truth to those faithful to His covenant & testimonies. For the sake of Your name L·rd – forgive my transgressions – for they are many. Who is this man that fears the L·rd – You lead him on the select path. His soul depends on good and his seed will inherit the land. The foundation of the L·rd is for those who fear Him and His covenant is for those that accept them. My eyes are constantly towards the L·rd – for he brings me out of the net on my feet. Turn to me and have grace upon me for I am unique and needy [person]. The sufferings of my heart have widened – from their pains You took me out. Observe my poverty and effort & remove all my sins. Observe my enemies, for they have increased. And with a violent hate did they despise me. Guard my soul and save me don't make me embarrassed for I place my trust in You. Simple and just You formed me – thus I put my trust in You. Redeem G·d Yisrael from all who cause them pain. And He will redeem Yisrael from all its sins:
L·rd, G·d of Yisrael – return from Your wrathful anger. And have mercy on the evil to to your people.

Our Father, Our King – You are our Father. Our Father, Our King We have no king, other than You. Our Father, Our King have mercy on us. Our Father, Our King – be Gracious and answer us – for we have no [valiant] deeds. Do righteousness and kindness with us – for the sake of Your great Name – and save us. And we – don't know what to do – for our eyes are upon You [to help us].

Recall Your mercy L·rd and Your kindness, for they are eternal. May your kindness L·rd be upon us – when we plead to You. Do not recall about us - our first sins – quickly let your mercy precede it – for we were very lowly. Help us in the Name of the L·rd. For we were subject greatly to degradation. In Your wrath, recall Your mercy. In Your wrath, recall Your love. L·rd save [us]! [You are] the King that answers on the day we call. For You knew our inclinations – remember that we are [only] dust. Help us – G·d of our salvation – for the matter of Your Name's honor. And save us and give atonement on our sins for the sake of Your Name.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. [Amen.] In the world that He created according to His will; may He establish His kingdom, cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. [Amen.] In your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say, Amen. [Amen.] May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, elevated and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. [Amen.] Beyond all the blessings, songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say, Amen. [Amen.]

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

Men of faith have perished, those who came by the strength of their deeds, mighty to stand in the breach, who turned away the decrees. They were a wall for us, and a refuge on the day of wrath. They extinguished anger with their whispered prayer and held back fury with their cry. Before they called You, You answered them; they knew how to entreat and to appease. As a father You had compassion for their sake; You did not turn their faces away empty. Through our many iniquities we lost them; they were gathered away from us through our sins. They have gone to their rest and left us to sighing. The builders of the fence have ceased; those who turned back wrath are cut off. None is left standing in the breach; those worthy of appeasing You have ceased. We have wandered to the four corners; we found no remedy. We have come back to You in shame, to seek You, God, in the time of our troubles.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

We are astounded by evils; our strength has failed from troubles. We have sunk exceedingly low; we have been brought down to the dust. Merciful One, such is our nature: we are stiff-necked and rebellious. We cried out with our mouths, “We have sinned,” and our heart is crooked and twisted. Most High, Your mercies are from of old; forgiveness is with You. Relent from the evil; incline toward kindness. Do not hide Yourself in times of trouble, O God, for we are in great distress. Let Your goodness and Your kindness toward us be known before the eyes of all. Seal the mouth of the accuser, and let him not accuse us; rage against him, and let him be silenced. Let a good advocate arise to vindicate us; let him declare our uprightness. Your ways, Merciful and Gracious One, You revealed to the faithful one of the house; when he sought them from You then, You made Your faithfulness known to him.

God, King who sits on the throne of mercy, who acts with loving-kindness, who pardons the iniquities of His people, who removes sins one by one, who increases forgiveness for sinners and pardon for transgressors, who deals righteously with all flesh and spirit, who does not repay them according to their deeds. God, You taught us to recite the Thirteen [Attributes], and remember for us today the covenant of the Thirteen, as You made known to the humble one of old, as it is written: “Hashem descended in a cloud and stood with him there, and He proclaimed the name of Hashem.” And there it is said:

“Hashem passed before him and proclaimed: Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and absolving.”

Our God and God of our fathers, do not make an end of us. Withhold Your hand in judgment when reproof comes before You; do not blot out our name from Your book. Come close to investigate [our] discipline; may Your mercies precede Your anger. Observe our poor deeds; bring righteousness near of Your own accord. Instruct us when we cry to You; command our salvation through the Intercessor. Restore the captivity of the tents of the perfect; see their gates, for they are desolate. Remember the faithful testimony; do not forget it from the mouth of his seed. Loosen the sealed testimony; place Your secret in our learning, the center of the rounded basin: let the mixed wine not be lacking. Yah, know Israel, who have known You; cast down the nations that have not known You. For You will restore to the stronghold the prisoners of hope.

What shall we say before You, You who dwell on high, and what shall we recount before You, You who abide in the heavens? Is it not that You know all that is hidden and all that is revealed? You know the secrets of the world and the hidden mysteries of every living being. You search all the chambers of the belly; You see the kidneys and the heart. Nothing is hidden from You, and nothing is concealed from before Your eyes.

May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that You forgive us all our sins, atone for all our iniquities, and pardon and forgive all our transgressions; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance.

Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed. For You, Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in kindness to all who call upon You. For Your name’s sake, Hashem, pardon my iniquity, for it is great. For Your name’s sake, Hashem, You will give me life; in Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble. Hashem of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. Hashem of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Bring us back to You, Hashem, and we shall return; renew our days as of old.

And He, the Merciful, forgives iniquity and does not destroy; He often turns back His anger and does not stir up all His wrath. You, Hashem, will not withhold Your mercies from me; Your kindness and Your truth will always guard me. Save us, Hashem our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy Name and to glory in Your praise. If You, Yah, should keep iniquities, Lord, who could stand? For with You is forgiveness, so that You may be feared. He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities. If our iniquities testify against us, Hashem, act for Your name’s sake. Remember Your mercies, Hashem, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. May Hashem answer you on the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, for we have no worthy deeds; deal with us in charity according to Your abundant mercy, and save us for Your name’s sake.

And now, my Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and made a name for Yourself, as this very day—we have sinned, we have acted wickedly. My Lord, according to all Your righteous acts, let Your anger and Your wrath turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people have become a reproach to all around us. And now, our God, hear the prayer of Your servant and his supplications, and cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate Sanctuary, for the sake of the Lord. Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolation, and the city upon which Your name is called; for not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before You, but on account of Your abundant mercy. My Lord, hear; my Lord, forgive; my Lord, listen and act, do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, for Your name is called upon Your city and Your people.

Our Father, merciful Father, show us a sign for good, and gather our scattered ones from the four corners of the earth. Let all the nations recognize and know that You, Hashem, are our Father. We are the clay and You are our Potter, and we are all the work of Your hand.

Our Father, our King, our Rock and our Redeemer, spare Your people, Hashem, and do not make Your inheritance a reproach, for the nations to rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, “Where is their God?” We know, Hashem, that we have sinned, and there is no one to stand up for us but Your great Name; let it stand by us in time of trouble. As a father has compassion for his children, have compassion on us. Pity Your people and have mercy on Your inheritance. Spare us, please, in Your abundant mercy; be gracious to us, our King, and answer us. Yours, Hashem, is righteousness; You work wonders at all times. Look, please, and save, please, the flock of Your pasture. Let no wrath rule over us, for Yours, Hashem, is the salvation; in You is our hope. God of forgiveness, please, forgive. For You are a good and forgiving God.

We beseech You, gracious and compassionate King: remember and look to the Covenant between the Pieces, and let the binding of the only one appear before You, and for the sake of Israel our father. Do not abandon us, our Father; do not cast us off, our King; do not forget us, our Maker; and do not make an end of us in our exile. For You are a gracious and compassionate God and King.

There is none like You, gracious and compassionate, our God; there is none like You, God slow to anger and abounding in kindness and truth. Save us and have mercy on us; from tumult and wrath deliver us. Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; do not look to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin. Turn from Your burning anger and relent from the evil to Your people. And remove from us the plague of death, for You are compassionate; for such is Your way, to do kindness freely in every generation. Please, Hashem, save us, please; please, Hashem, grant us success, please. Please, Hashem, answer us on the day we call. For You, Hashem, we have hoped; for You, Hashem, we have waited; for You, Hashem, we have longed; do not be silent, and answer us. For the nations say: their hope is lost. Every knee shall bow to You, and every upright one shall prostrate before You.

You who open Your hand in repentance to receive transgressors and sinners: our soul is dismayed by the abundance of our sorrow. Do not forget us forever; arise and save us. Do not pour out Your wrath upon us, for we are Your people, the children of Your covenant. God, look! Our honor has been diminished among the nations, and they abhor us as something impure. How long will Your strength be in captivity, and Your glory in the hand of the foe? Let them see and be ashamed, let them be dismayed at their might. Awaken Your might and save us for the sake of Your Name. Let our troubles not be small before You; let Your mercies quickly come to meet us in the time of our distress. Not for our sake but for Yours, act, and do not destroy the remembrance of our remnant. For our eyes look to You, for You are a gracious and compassionate God and King. And remember our testimony every day continually, we who say twice daily with love: “Hear, O Israel, Hashem is our God, Hashem is One.”

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. [Amen.] In the world that He created according to His will; may He establish His kingdom, cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. [Amen.] In your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say, Amen. [Amen.] May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, elevated and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. [Amen.] Beyond all the blessings, songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say, Amen. [Amen.]

segs.en: Torah Scroll
segs.text: ספר תורה

segs.en: Before taking out the Torah scroll on a day with Tachanun, say:
segs.text: <small>לפני הוצאת ספר תורה ביום שיש בו תחנון אומרים:</small>
אֶל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת, אֶל בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנוּ, חוּסָה יְהֹוָה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ מִכָּל רָע, חָטָאנוּ לְךָ, אָדוֹן סְלַח נָא, כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ אֶל:

אֶל אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּמַלֵּא רַחֲמִים, אֶל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנּוּ, חוּסָה יְהֹוָה עַל שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ, וְהַצִּילֵנוּ מִכָּל רָע, חָטָאנוּ לְךָ, אֲדוֹן סְלַח נָא, כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ אֶל:

segs.en: On a day without Tachanun, say:
segs.text: <small>ביום שאין בו תחנון אומרים:</small>

יְהִ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ עִמָּ֔נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵ֖נוּ וְאַֽל־יִטְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃ הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה ׀ אֶת־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃ בַּֽ֭עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

parts.en: When taking out the Torah scroll, say:

parts.text: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֱׁיְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃ גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃ רוֹמְמ֡וּ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃ רוֹמְמ֡וּ יְהֹ֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּי־קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ אֵין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיהֹוָ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב׃ עֵץ־חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃ דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹ֑עַם וְֽכׇל־נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃ שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃ יְֽהֹוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהֹוָ֓ה ׀ יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃

segs.en: When reaching the bimah, the scroll is raised and the text shown to the congregation, and they say:
segs.text: <small>כשמגיע לדוכן, מגביה את ספר התורה ומראה הכתב לקהל ואומרים</small>

וְזֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב׃ הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֢ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל ׀ הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃

parts.en: And the person called up says:
And the person called up says:
And the person called up repeats:

segs.en: And the person called up blesses before the reading
segs.text: <small>ומברך העולה לפני הקריאה</small>

parts.text: אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה,

segs.en: After the reading, the one called up blesses
segs.text: <small>אחר הקריאה מברך העולה</small>

parts.text: אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת,
וְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם נָטַע בְּתוֹכֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה,

segs.en: Birkat HaGomel is found in the Shabbat Torah reading order
segs.text: ברכת הגומל נמצא בסדר קריאת התורה של שבת

segs.en: The last one called up says Half Kaddish
segs.text: <small>העולה האחרון אומר חצי קדיש</small>

parts.text: <small> בְּעָלְמָא דִּי בְרָא, כִּרְעוּתֵה, וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵה, וְיַצְמַח פֻּרְקָנֵה, וִיקָרֵב מְשִׁיחֵהּ.</small>
<small> בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.</small>

<small> יְהֵא שְׁמֵיהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח. וְיִתְפָּאַר. וְיִתְרוֹמַם. וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא. וְיִתְהַדָּר. וְיִתְעַלֶּה. וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְּקֻדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא.</small>
<small> לְעֵלָּא מִן כָּל בִּרְכָתָא שִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן.</small>

segs.text: God, slow to anger and abounding in kindness and truth, do not rebuke us in Your anger. Spare Israel Your people, Hashem, and save us from all evil. We have sinned against You; Master, please forgive, according to Your abundant mercy, O God.

God, slow to anger and full of compassion, do not hide Your face from us. Spare the remnant of Israel Your people, Hashem, and rescue us from all evil. We have sinned against You; Master, please forgive, according to Your abundant mercy, O God.

May Hashem our God be with us as He was with our fathers; may He not forsake us or abandon us. Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; tend them and carry them forever. For the sake of David Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed.
